HOW THIS WORKS

Instructions

You're a sound detective — every clip is a clue.

  • 🎧 Step 1: Tap "▶ Play Clue" on any case card to hear the appliance sound.

  • 🔍 Step 3: Tap "Reveal Evidence" to uncover the photo, its name, and what it's used for.
  • 💬 Step 4: Answer the follow-up question together to keep the conversation going.
  • ✅ Work through all 10 cases in any order — solve them all to close the file!
